name: Stained Glass
author: Spine
description: Cathedral jewel-tone glass panes framed in dark leadwork with warm gold highlights. Also serves as Spine's example theme for creators.

options.label: Color mood
options.note: Changes the jewel-tone lighting across the window and accent color.

options.label: Lead framing
options.note: Adds dark cathedral lead-line borders and metallic inner bevels around panels.

options.label: Backlight glow
options.note: Illuminates focused tiles and buttons like sunlight shining through glass.
